value.rationale: The theorem computes a natural exact Euclidean invariant of every complete multipartite symmetric-edge polytope with at least three classes and classifies/counts all tangent facets to the canonical centered inball. The maximum of a balanced-cut term and a large-part term causes a genuine size threshold, with a rare parity-tie case (78 contacts for four size-two classes versus 924 binary-only contacts for four size-three classes). It supplies geometric contact structure not conveyed by face counts or Ehrhart polynomials.
